items.title: SEC Charges BG Wealth and DSJ Exchange in Alleged $130 Million Crypto Fraud
items.summary: The agency says investors lost more than $100 million after the firms promised risk-free trading returns and used false filings to claim SEC approval.

items.title: India's ED Announces Searches in $524 Million Crypto Transfer Probe
items.summary: The agency named Binance and Bybit as platforms used for alleged foreign payouts, without announcing charges against either exchange.
